# Mogens Software

> B2B software development practice. We build custom software, AI agent
> integrations, and cloud infrastructure. Small, senior, independent
> team — no account managers, direct communication with the people
> building your system.

## Services

- Custom AI agents & RAG pipelines — LLM workflows integrated into existing databases
- Custom software development — microservices, Rust/Go backends, low-latency APIs
- Automated business logic — n8n/Python orchestration
- Cloud infrastructure & DevOps — Kubernetes, AWS/GCP, zero-downtime CI/CD

## Integrations we build for clients

- Website language switcher / multi-language integration
- AI website assistant integration (chat-based, deployable on web, desktop, or mobile)
- Digital menu integration for restaurants and cafés (QR-based)
- Online reservation / booking portal integration for service businesses

## Case studies (real, shipped, currently live)

- Slotly — multi-tenant booking SaaS for service businesses: https://slotly-jet.vercel.app/
- QR Menu — multi-tenant digital menu platform: https://qr-menugit.streamlit.app/
- Mogens Software AI — chat-based personal assistant, desktop & Android

## How we work

1. Discovery call — short technical conversation, no sales deck
2. Architecture & build — short iterations, working code shown early
3. Test & deploy — tests and CI/CD pipeline, zero-downtime
4. Support & iterate — direct access post-launch, no ticket queue

## Facts

- 3 live production systems shipped
- 6 languages supported on this website (en, tr, es, it, ar, zh)
